data.heading: What Matters Most To You?
data.lede: Tell us your priority and we'll recommend the best protection solution for you.
data.hint: Tap a priority to see our recommendation — your choice is saved in the link, so you can share it.

image.alt: Cool blue tones: frosted glass texture or air-conditioned interior feel.

recommendation.title: Beat the heat at the glass, before it gets in.
recommendation.body: Whether it's your car cabin, living room or office floor, the fastest way to a cooler space is rejecting infrared heat at the window. Our multi-layer sputtered films reject up to 98% of infrared heat (1400nm) without darkening the room.

image.alt: Close-up of a healthy eye or face in soft daylight near a window.

recommendation.title: Block UV400 and HEV blue light — every day, invisibly.
recommendation.body: Daily exposure through car and building glass adds up. IrisPro's patented UV+420™ goes beyond ordinary UV400 films, cutting HEV blue light (380–420nm) that penetrates deeper into skin and eyes.

image.alt: Electricity bill with a falling bar chart and a piggy bank.

recommendation.title: Less heat in means less cooling paid for.
recommendation.body: Cooling is the biggest line on most Malaysian electricity bills. Rejecting solar heat at the windows lowers air-conditioning load — typically up to 30% off cooling energy, at home or in a building.

image.alt: Pristine leather car interior, dashboard and seats in good light.

recommendation.title: Stop the fade, cracks and that baked-dashboard smell.
recommendation.body: UV and infrared heat quietly destroy leather, trim and electronics. Blocking 99.9% of UV and most solar heat keeps your interior — and your resale value — looking new for years.

image.alt: Family relaxing together on a sofa in a bright, comfortable living room.

recommendation.title: Every room comfortable, all day — even facing west.
recommendation.body: Home window films keep rooms cooler and glare-free while protecting your family's skin and your furniture, without blocking the view or the daylight.

image.alt: Team working comfortably in a bright office beside large windows.

recommendation.title: Comfortable employees do better work.
recommendation.body: Heat zones and screen glare quietly tax productivity. Commercial films even out temperatures, cut glare and reduce HVAC cost — while contributing to your ESG story.

image.alt: Green globe or lush foliage — clean sustainability visual.

recommendation.title: Lower energy demand is the easiest carbon win.
recommendation.body: Every kilowatt-hour of cooling you don't use is carbon you don't emit — up to 1.2 tons of CO₂ per building per year. Window film is one of the simplest efficiency upgrades there is.
